steps.note: Open a project create screen where the Savings panel is available.
Provide the required event title so the create flow is valid.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items and using Savings.
Add a line item so the Savings control becomes available.
Complete the pricing sheet needed for the Savings panel.
Open the Savings panel specified by the test setup.

args.goal: In the open Savings panel, click Add Custom Reference, enter the name Best Price, save it, select a calculation column for the new custom strategy, and stop with the panel showing Best Price together with its selected column

Verify that the newly created custom reference appears in the Savings panel.
